description: This file defines the Spanish (Costa Rica) culture information for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and additional date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing today with time cleared.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a timezone given its name.
